name: Iron Beam 100 kW laser (Rafael)
description: Rafael Iron Beam ('Or Eitan'), 100 kW-class laser handed to the Israeli Air Force 28 Dec 2025: the first high-energy laser air-defence system declared operationally mature. Reported to burn rockets, mortars and UAS at about 10 km in clear air; interception takes seconds. Fires from a static emplacement and degrades badly in cloud, fog and low visibility, which is why Iron Dome remains the all-weather layer.

maxRangeM.note: Inventory records 10000 m (10 km); the seed value is kept

engageTimeS.condition: dwell time to effect — An Israeli defence official said 'the interception takes seconds'. A separate lower-tier report gives about five seconds. Five is used as the representative reading of 'seconds'; it is target-dependent and not a published threshold.
engageTimeS.source: Breaking Defense, 'Lasers in the field: Iron Beam clears last test before operational use'
